about.title: About Foxzil
about.p1: Foxzil is a website that presents deals, discounts, and coupons collected from a range of online stores. Our goal is to help shoppers find genuine savings in one place — from coupon codes and cashback to seasonal offers and flash sales.
about.p2: The deals and offers you see here are made available via different affiliate networks. When you click through and shop, you pay the same price as usual — Foxzil simply earns a small commission from the network, which keeps this service free for you.
about.p3: Foxzil or its staff is not involved when you make a purchase via these links. Any order, payment, delivery, or support is handled directly by the store you shop with.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Foxzil handles information when you use our website. By using Foxzil, you agree to the practices described below.
privacy.collectBody: We collect limited, non-personal information such as your approximate region (to show the right deals and currency) and basic, anonymous usage analytics that help us improve the site.
privacy.affiliateBody: The deals and offers on Foxzil are made available via different affiliate networks. When you click a link, the network may set a cookie to attribute your purchase so that Foxzil can earn a commission. Foxzil or its staff is not involved when you make a purchase via these links — the transaction happens entirely on the store's own website.
privacy.cookiesBody: We use cookies to remember your selected region and to enable affiliate tracking. You can control or delete cookies through your browser settings at any time.
privacy.contactBody: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please reach out to us through the website.
